workflows.name: SubmitContactForm
steps: User fills in name, email, and message.
On success, status becomes 'success' and a confirmation message is shown.
On failure, status becomes 'error' and an error message is shown.

workflows.name: BrowseFeatures
workflows.description: User scrolls through the features section.
steps: User navigates to the features section.
Feature cards are displayed with animations.
User can hover over cards to see effects.
